presentation.label: Abdominal pain
presentation.free_text_prompt: Tell us more about your abdominal pain: when it started, what other symptoms you have such as diarrhoea or bleeding, any clear triggers
pre_form_information: If you have severe pain, please call the surgery and ask to speak to the duty doctor, or call 111 or 999 if it is out of hours.  Online consultation is only for routine queries

questions.question: Are you experiencing pain in your abdomen or stomach area?
Has the pain been severe at any point?
Has the pain been associated with nausea or vomiting?
